prompts.description: Translate onboarding option-label arrays (goals/activity/diet/pace/budget/body-type/category tabs) to Korean in place
prompts.prompt:
Edit ONLY components/onboarding.tsx. Replace the English `label`, `description`, and `hint` text VALUES in the option arrays with Korean, in place. Do NOT change any `id`, `multiplier`, `category`, `cost`, icon JSX, or ingredient-name string. Apply exactly:
GOALS: 'Lose Fat'→'체지방 감량' / desc 'Slightly fewer calories, with protein to help you stay full'→'칼로리는 살짝 줄이고, 포만감을 위해 단백질은 충분히'; 'Gain Muscle'→'근육 증가' / 'A bit more fuel to support strength work and recovery'→'근력 운동과 회복을 돕도록 칼로리를 조금 더'; 'Lean Recomposition'→'린 리컴프(체지방↓근육↑)' / 'Steady eating with room to train and trim fat over time'→'꾸준히 먹으면서 시간을 두고 체지방을 줄이고 근육은 유지'.
ACTIVITY: 'Sedentary'→'거의 안 움직임' / 'Mostly desk or home, little planned exercise'→'주로 책상·집에서 생활, 계획된 운동은 거의 없음'; 'Light activity'→'가벼운 활동' / 'Easy walks, light workouts, or on-your-feet days'→'가벼운 산책·운동, 또는 서서 일하는 날'; 'Moderate'→'보통' / 'Regular workouts or active job, most weeks'→'대부분 주에 규칙적인 운동 또는 활동적인 직업'; 'Very active'→'매우 활발' / 'Hard training or very physical days most of the week'→'주 대부분 강도 높은 훈련이나 육체 활동'.
DIET: 'Keto'→'키토' / 'Fewer carbs, more fat—if that's how you like to eat'→'탄수화물은 적게, 지방은 많게 — 이런 식사를 선호한다면'; 'High Protein'→'고단백' / 'Extra protein in each day's mix'→'매일 단백질 비중을 더 높게'; 'Balanced'→'균형' / 'Carbs, protein, and fat in an even split'→'탄수화물·단백질·지방을 고르게 배분'; 'Intermittent Fasting'→'간헐적 단식' / 'Fewer, larger meals in a set eating window'→'정해진 시간대에 끼니는 적게, 양은 크게'.
PACE (label / hint): 'Steady'→'천천히' / 'Easier to maintain, minimal muscle loss'→'유지하기 쉽고 근손실 최소'; 'Moderate'→'보통' / 'Balanced pace, good for most people'→'균형 잡힌 속도, 대부분에게 적합'; 'Aggressive'→'빠르게' / 'Faster results, requires more discipline'→'결과는 빠르지만 더 큰 절제가 필요'.
BUDGET (label only — leave the ingredient string arrays in English): 'Budget-friendly'→'가성비'; 'Balanced spend'→'적당한 지출'; 'More variety'→'다양하게'.
BODY TYPE: 'Slim'→'마른 편' / 'Naturally lean build, lower body fat'→'타고나게 마른 체형, 낮은 체지방'; 'Average'→'보통' / 'Typical build, moderate body fat'→'평균 체형, 보통 체지방'; 'Athletic'→'탄탄한 편' / 'Visibly muscular, active lifestyle'→'눈에 띄게 근육질, 활동적인 생활'; 'Heavy'→'건장한 편' / 'Carrying extra weight currently'→'현재 체중이 다소 있는 편'.
CATEGORY TABS: 'Protein'→'단백질'; 'Carbs'→'탄수화물'; 'Fats'→'지방'; 'Vegetables'→'채소'.
Also: ingredientMinimumMessage 'Select at least 2 proteins, 1 carb, and 1 fat to continue'→'계속하려면 단백질 2개, 탄수화물 1개, 지방 1개 이상 선택하세요'.
Verify: npm run build passes; in Korean, the goal/activity/diet/pace/budget/body-type cards and the ingredient category tabs all show Korean labels.

prompts.description: Display ingredient names in Korean in the onboarding picker via localizeIngredientName (without changing stored data)
prompts.prompt: Building on lib/ingredient-i18n.ts, edit ONLY components/onboarding.tsx so ingredient NAMES render in Korean without changing stored data. Add `import { localizeIngredientName } from '@/lib/ingredient-i18n'`. onboarding already destructures the store at `const { setUserProfile, setCurrentStep, calculateMacros } = useMealStore()` — add `appPrefs` to that destructure and add `const language = appPrefs.language`. Then wrap every place an ingredient name is DISPLAYED to the user with localizeIngredientName(name, language): the ingredient catalog grid cards, the search-results rows (the `{item.name}` around line 2262), the selected-ingredient chips/list, and the pending add label ('Add {pendingClaudeIngredient.name}' around line 2314). Do NOT touch any place `name` is used as LOGIC: `item.name.toLowerCase().includes(...)`, `key={item.name}`, `selectedIngredients.includes(item.name)`, `onClick={() => addIngredientFromSearch(item.name)}`, or any state value — those keep the original English name. Do NOT edit the ingredientCatalog `name` fields or the budget preset ingredient arrays. Verify: npm run build passes; in Korean the picker shows 닭가슴살/흰쌀밥/올리브유 etc., and searching, selecting, and deselecting ingredients still work correctly.

prompts.description: Translate all remaining visible onboarding chrome (step chips, labels, helper text, buttons, placeholders) to Korean in place
prompts.prompt: Edit ONLY components/onboarding.tsx. Translate ALL remaining user-visible English UI text to natural Korean, in place. Known strings to apply: step chips 'Step N of 8'→'8단계 중 N단계' (keep the number N, all 8 of them); 'Gender'→'성별'; 'Measurement system'→'단위 시스템'; 'This sets both your body inputs and recipe measurements.'→'신체 입력값과 레시피 단위를 함께 설정해요.'; 'This switches both your estimate inputs and recipe measurements.'→'추정 입력값과 레시피 단위를 함께 전환해요.'; placeholder 'Search ingredients...'→'재료 검색...'; age placeholders 'e.g., 18'/'e.g., 30'→'예: 18'/'예: 30'; 'per 100g'→'100g당'; the add button word 'Add'→'추가'. Buttons: 'Continue — '→'계속 — ' (keep the dynamic label after it); 'Continue with this target'→'이 목표로 계속'; 'Continue with these cuisines'→'이 요리들로 계속'; 'Continue with this cuisine'→'이 요리로 계속'; 'Continue with a starter list'→'추천 재료로 계속'; 'Continue with custom ingredients'→'선택한 재료로 계속'; 'Continue with this setup'→'이 구성으로 계속'; any 'Build my plan'→'내 플랜 만들기'; 'Back'→'뒤로'; 'Continue'→'계속'. Then translate EVERY other still-English visible string in the file: step headings, subheadings, helper sentences, toggle/path copy (e.g. quick-estimate vs precise entry), and any empty/loading/error text. GUARDRAILS — do NOT change: any `id`/value/`category`/`multiplier`/`cost` field, ingredient NAME strings (catalog names and budget preset ingredient arrays stay English data keys), className strings, imports, icon JSX, variable/function names, or the localizeIngredientName(...) name displays added in the previous step. Translate human-visible text only. Verify: npm run build passes; walking all 8 onboarding steps in Korean shows no remaining English chrome.
